header: L6 · The test architect who has seen coverage lie · sonnet
verdict: Close: the 4 Status A or M findings of round 10 read as resolved; the delta adds two test-side gaps, a fingerprint guard whose mismatch branch has no named test and a go list -deps test with no red fixture.

findings.defect: I17 names only the equal-fingerprint E case (resume at sbx env rm); no case makes the fresh fingerprint differ, so removing the comparison (always resume) leaves every named test green.
findings.scenario: A refactor resumes unconditionally; a commit or untracked file made after the failed sbx env rm is destroyed with the sandbox, and I17 stays green.
findings.change: Add E cases to I17: dirty a worktree (tracked, untracked, ignored file content) or move a daemon head between the failed rm and its rerun, and assert the generation goes removing -> salvaging with a new salvage entry and sbx env rm is not called before it.

findings.defect: The go list -deps test is specified as a property but names no fixture that makes it red (an import outside the approvals globs), and does not say whether it runs with -test or how it tells the standard library from a module path.
findings.scenario: The test filters on a prefix that also matches a third-party path or skips non-stdlib detection; a dependency enters tools/ci/pr and the test stays green.
findings.change: Name a fixture package importing a path outside the globs and a mutation row (remove the glob check, the test fails), and state the stdlib rule (no dot in the first path element).
